title: Leaf-cutter ant mounds resembling a Mesoamerican city at La Venta

tellings.quote: I was in Mexico. I was I was at this ch site called Lventa. I'm standing at at the base of the Great Pyramid of Lamenta

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns says that leaf-cutter ant mounds look strikingly like the layout of an ancient Mexican city, an idea that came to him while standing at the base of the Great Pyramid of La Venta, an ancient site in Mexico. He tells it from his own visit. He brings it up to suggest that ancient pyramid builders may have copied patterns from nature.
